title: Scott Galloway FIRES BACK at MAGA Id*ot Michael Knowles in HEATED Debate!
description:
Scott Galloway sits down on Piers Morgan Uncensored and ends up in one of the sharpest exchanges the show has seen this year, going head to head with conservative commentator Michael Knowles over a deceptively simple question: is refusing to spend your money a legitimate form of protest, or is it something closer to economic sabotage? What starts as a calm explanation of a consumer campaign quickly turns into a heated clash about power, markets, and how ordinary people can push back against policies they disagree with.

In this segment, Galloway lays out the thinking behind his Resist and Unsubscribe idea, a campaign encouraging people to cancel big tech subscriptions they do not need and to be more intentional about where their money goes. He frames it as the most radical act available in a capitalist society, nonparticipation, and he backs it up by pointing to how fragile the current market really is when only a handful of enormous companies carry the overwhelming majority of the earnings that prop up the entire index. He also puts his own money where his mouth is, openly admitting he owns stock in major tech firms and has already started selling it off to lead by example.

Michael Knowles pushes back hard, calling the whole effort a desperation play and arguing that it amounts to trying to damage the companies holding up the economy out of political frustration.
